prompt.name: Soutien cybernétique MSF
prompt.prompt: Create ONE finished 2D/2.5D fighting-game character sprite, ONE full body only, isolated on a truly transparent background. Single static neutral-ready pose facing screen RIGHT, three-quarter side view, head and feet both visible, feet on one common ground baseline. Portrait composition, complete silhouette with at least 5 percent transparent margin all round. Match the refined hand-painted game-sprite style and identity of the first standing figure in the reference, not the whole atlas. Clean solid outlines, precise material shading, readable anatomy and equipment attachments. Do not make a sprite sheet, pose variations, multiple characters, comparison layout, text, captions, UI, backdrop, floor, cast shadow, glow or atmospheric haze. The requested clothes are an original CQC costume, not an official released-game outfit. Preserve the same period-specific character and do not borrow another incarnation. KAZUHIRA MILLER from Peace Walker in 1974, original external cybernetic support costume “Soutien cybernétique MSF”. Preserve the younger adult Kaz face, slicked-back medium-length blond hair, black aviator sunglasses, mustard-yellow neck scarf and MSF olive palette from the reference. He still has TWO biological arms and TWO biological legs beneath an EXTERNAL powered chassis; do not import his later MGSV amputations. Design convincing high-quality Revengeance-style engineered armor: angular olive and graphite segmented breastplate, exposed precise shoulder linkages, plated articulated forearms, black mechanical gauntlets, angular thigh/knee/shin armor with restrained metallic piston struts and yellow insulated cable accents. The armor has credible hard-surface structure, exposed joints and fasteners rather than cloth with shiny printed lines. Keep a small round MSF-style shoulder emblem without legible words, and a compact radio pack integrated with the back support. No white Raiden body copy, no skull face, no weapon raised. One confident neutral standing stance facing right.

visualReview.description: 1974 Kaz identity with all four biological limbs beneath external bespoke mechanical support frame.
visualReview.note: Physically viewed: younger 1974 Kaz, aviators and yellow scarf; all four biological limbs beneath an olive hard-surface external support chassis. Separate from 1984 amputee identity.
visualReview.limits: Original CQC design; no claim of official outfit or exact recovered historical pixels. Anchor is preliminary and may be refined in catalogue QA.
